verdict.rationale: Crossmint's docs describe agents paying merchants (agent wallets, agent cards, agent checkouts) and general payments/checkout infrastructure, but there is no evidence of a merchant-facing self-serve path — no toggle, agreement, or endpoint-publishing guide — for a merchant to explicitly opt in to accepting agent-driven traffic (e.g., no documented way to register as an x402-accepting seller or join an 'agent checkout' merchant program).
